Partner Autocomplete from State Registers (CZ/SK)

Fills contacts from the Czech and Slovak business registers instead of Odoo's paid autocomplete service, choosing the register by the partner's country.

Version19.0.1.3.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requirespartner_autocomplete, web
Extended bypartner_autocomplete_ares_cz, partner_autocomplete_orsf_sk

What it is for

Odoo's own partner autocomplete looks companies up in Odoo's paid in-app-purchase service. For Czech and Slovak partners the authoritative source is the state business register, keyed by the company's identification number (IČO). This module is the switch between the two: it lets each company choose a provider for partner autocomplete and sends name searches, VAT-number searches and the final "fill in the contact" step to that provider.

On its own it does nothing visible. It is installed together with one or both providers:

Provider Register Countries Guide
ARES.CZ ARES, the Czech register of economic subjects CZ below
ORSF.SK ORSF, an open aggregation of the Slovak registers (RPO, ORSR, ŽRSR, RÚZ, Finančná správa) SK partner_autocomplete_orsf_sk

Setting it up

  1. Install a provider module. The dispatcher comes with it.
  2. Settings → General Settings, block Contacts: Partner Autocomplete must be enabled.
  3. Under it, Provider — choose the register for the current company. Odoo's "buy credits" link is replaced by this choice. Provider-specific settings appear below it when that provider is selected.

The provider is stored per company. Switch to each company and set it there.

Two choices are not registers:

  • Odoo IAP hands the search back to Odoo's own service, exactly as without this module. Every search for a partner whose country no installed provider reads leaves for Odoo.
  • None looks nothing up outside the national registers. A partner in a provider's country is still looked up there (see below); anything else finds nothing, and nothing is sent to Odoo.

None is the default. Until version 19.0.1.2.0 None was the label of what is now Odoo IAP, which was also the default; the upgrade to 19.0.1.3.0 moved every company on it to the real None. Choose Odoo IAP if you want Odoo's service for partners outside the national registers.

Which register is asked

The country decides first, the company's choice second:

  • A provider declares the countries whose register it reads — ARES reads CZ, ORSF reads SK. When the contact's Country is one of them (or, in a VAT search, the VAT number starts with that country's prefix), that provider is asked, whatever the company has chosen. A Slovak company can autocomplete a Czech supplier from ARES and the other way round, as long as both providers are installed.
  • For any other country, or with no country, the company's Provider is asked.
  • When you pick a suggestion, the details are fetched from the same register that offered it. This matters because a Czech and a Slovak IČO both have eight digits.

Filling in a contact

Type at least three characters of the company name — or its IČO — into the name field of a new contact, or a VAT number into Tax ID, and pick one of the suggestions. The provider fills the address, the identifiers and whatever else it supports; see the provider's guide for the exact list.

What the providers return can include bank accounts and contacts. On the company form (Settings → Companies) the module therefore adds two tabs, Bank Accounts and Contacts, so that autocompleting your own company can fill them too. When the provider replaces a list (bank accounts, register lists), the old rows are removed rather than duplicated.

Updating existing contacts

Select one or more contacts in the list and run Actions → Update. Each contact is looked up again in its register and overwritten with what the register says.

The register asked is the one an earlier autocomplete recorded on the contact, otherwise the register of the contact's Country, otherwise the company's Provider — the same order as for a search.

The number used for the lookup is the contact's own:

  • the IČO a previous autocomplete recorded on it, or
  • Company ID (company_registry) — but only on a company, or on a person with no parent company (a sole trader). A contact person inside a company carries the company's number, copied there by Odoo, and is skipped: looking up that number would overwrite the person with the company's name and address.

When more than one contact was selected, or something went wrong, a notification counts the outcomes: updated, skipped (nothing to search by), with no data returned, and failed (the cause is in the server log).

The registers limit how many full records may be read per minute, so Update on a large selection starts returning nothing partway through. That shows up as with no data returned, not as an error. For many Slovak contacts use ORSF's bulk refresh instead.

Enriching contacts during an import

An import file may carry a column Import Enrich Company holding the IČO. Each imported contact with a value in it is looked up and filled in from the register as it is created. Contacts created by hand are never looked up behind your back: saving a new company with a Company ID does not trigger a lookup.

ARES (Czech Republic)

partner_autocomplete_ares_cz reads the public ARES service of the Czech Ministry of Finance. No account or key is needed.

  • Searching. By company name: the first five matches, shown as name, city (IČO). Typing an IČO as digits offers that company. A Czech VAT number typed into Tax ID finds the company when it is a legal person's DIČ (CZ + the eight-digit IČO) and ARES confirms that DIČ for it.
  • Filled in: name, street, PSČ, city, country and Tax ID with the DIČ as ARES publishes it.
  • Settings (shown when ARES is the company's provider):
Setting What it does
IČO The contact field that receives the IČO. Empty by default, so the IČO is not stored anywhere until you choose a field, typically Company ID.
Prevailing activity (CZ-NACE 2025) The contact field that receives the prevailing activity from ARES's copy of the statistical register (RES). Points at NACE (main activity) automatically when partner_nace is installed. Costs one extra request per lookup; leave it empty to skip it.
  • Limits. ARES offers no search by VAT number; a natural person's DIČ (ten digits, derived from the birth number) has no IČO to try and finds nothing. ARES returns the DIČ whether or not the company is currently registered for VAT; check the VAT status before relying on it for reverse charge. Bank accounts and contact persons are not filled.

Limitations

  • A provider answering with nothing looks the same whether the company does not exist, the register is down or the rate limit was hit. The server log tells them apart.
  • The settings field labels of this module are not translated.
